output.summary: A palm native to southern Pakistan, most of India, Nepal, Bhutan, Myanmar and Bangladesh, it bears single-seeded fruit that ripens purple-red. The fruit is made into wine and jelly, while tapped sap is drunk fresh or fermented into toddy and, in West Bengal and Bangladesh, boiled into palm jaggery.
